ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: there is a latitude-longitude grid in the figure, line EF is roughly north-south in direction, located near about 60°E, and mountain symbols are drawn on the line; M is marked on the west side of line EF, and N is marked on the east side. Then reason: the north-south mountain range near about 60°E should be the Ural Mountains. The west side of the Ural Mountains is the East European Plain, and the east side is the West Siberian Plain. Although the specific names of the terrain regions on the two sides are different, the terrain types both belong to plains. Therefore, the two sides of the mountain range along EF have the same terrain type.

method.method_draft: 先读图：EF是一条近南北走向、带山脉符号的线，位于约60°E附近，两侧分别标有M、N。再结合文字问题，明确要比较的是EF线上山脉两侧的“地形类型”。利用区域地理知识判断：60°E附近、南北走向的山脉是乌拉尔山脉，其西侧为东欧平原，东侧为西西伯利亚平原。两者名称不同，但地形类型都属于平原，所以回答：具有相同的地形类型。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中有经纬网，EF线大致呈南北走向，位于约60°E附近，线上画有山脉符号；EF线西侧标有M，东侧标有N。再推理：约60°E附近南北走向的山脉应为乌拉尔山脉。乌拉尔山脉西侧是东欧平原，东侧是西西伯利亚平原。两侧虽然具体地形区名称不同，但地形类型都属于平原。因此，EF线上山脉两侧具有相同的地形类型。
